objects.description: Exit code enumeration used by the streaming API. XXH_OK indicates success and XXH_ERROR indicates failure.
Unsigned 32-bit hash value type returned by the XXH32 family. Under some platforms it may typedef to unsigned int/long to ensure 32-bit width.

Opaque handle to the XXH32 streaming state. Allocate via XXH32_createState() and free via XXH32_freeState(). Do not access internals unless XXH_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY (then struct XXH32_state_s is defined).
Canonical big-endian byte representation of an XXH32_hash_t (4 bytes). Used for portable storage/transfer.
Unsigned 64-bit hash value type returned by the XXH64 and XXH3 64-bit variants. On some platforms it may typedef to unsigned long/unsigned long long to ensure 64-bit width.

Opaque handle to the XXH64 streaming state. Allocate via XXH64_createState() and free via XXH64_freeState(). Do not access internals unless XXH_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY (then struct XXH64_state_s is defined).

objects.definition: typedef struct { unsigned char digest[sizeof(XXH64_hash_t)]; } XXH64_canonical_t;
objects.description: Canonical big-endian byte representation of an XXH64_hash_t. Size equals sizeof(XXH64_hash_t).

Opaque handle to the XXH3 streaming state used for both 64-bit and 128-bit XXH3. Allocate via XXH3_createState() and free via XXH3_freeState(). Do not access internals unless XXH_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY (then struct XXH3_state_s is defined with strict 64-byte alignment).
128-bit hash value structure returned by XXH3 128-bit variants. low64 contains the low bits; high64 contains the high bits.

objects.definition: typedef struct { unsigned char digest[sizeof(XXH128_hash_t)]; } XXH128_canonical_t;
objects.description: Canonical big-endian byte representation of an XXH128_hash_t (16 bytes).

objects.definition:
struct XXH32_state_s {
   XXH32_hash_t total_len_32; /*!< Total length hashed, modulo 2^32 */
   XXH32_hash_t large_len;    /*!< Whether the hash is >= 16 (handles @ref total_len_32 overflow) */
   XXH32_hash_t acc[4];       /*!< Accumulator lanes */
   unsigned char buffer[16];  /*!< Internal buffer for partial reads. */
   XXH32_hash_t bufferedSize; /*!< Amount of data in @ref buffer */
   XXH32_hash_t reserved;     /*!< Reserved field. Do not read nor write to it. */
};   /* typedef'd to XXH32_state_t */
objects.description: Concrete definition of the XXH32 streaming state. Exposed only when XXH_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY/XXH_INLINE_ALL/XXH_IMPLEMENTATION is defined. Do not access fields unless statically linking with matching version. Must be zeroed/reset via XXH32_reset before use.

objects.definition:
struct XXH64_state_s {
   XXH64_hash_t total_len;    /*!< Total length hashed. This is always 64-bit. */
   XXH64_hash_t acc[4];       /*!< Accumulator lanes */
   unsigned char buffer[32];  /*!< Internal buffer for partial reads.. */
   XXH32_hash_t bufferedSize; /*!< Amount of data in @ref buffer */
   XXH32_hash_t reserved32;   /*!< Reserved field, needed for padding anyways*/
   XXH64_hash_t reserved64;   /*!< Reserved field. Do not read or write to it. */
};   /* typedef'd to XXH64_state_t */
objects.description: Concrete definition of the XXH64 streaming state. Exposed only in static linking/inline modes. Do not access fields unless statically linking with matching version.

Concrete definition of the XXH3 streaming state (used for both 64-bit and 128-bit). Requires 64-byte alignment; must be allocated via XXH3_createState or as a properly aligned stack object. Fields are unstable; only access via API. Initialize via XXH3_64bits_reset/XXH3_128bits_reset or XXH3_INITSTATE macro before reset-with-seed path.

functions.name: XXH32
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_PUREF XXH32_hash_t XXH32(const void* input, size_t length, XXH32_hash_t seed)
functions.description: Computes a 32-bit xxHash of a contiguous memory block in a single call.
requirements: If length > 0, [input, input+length) must be valid, readable, contiguous memory.
If length == 0, input may be NULL.
In C++, the pointed-to objects must be TriviallyCopyable.

functions.name: XXH32_createState

functions.name: XXH32_freeState
functions.signature: XXH_PUBLIC_API XXH_errorcode XXH32_freeState(XXH32_state_t* statePtr)
functions.description: Frees an XXH32_state_t previously allocated by XXH32_createState(). Returns XXH_OK.
requirements: statePtr must have been allocated by XXH32_createState().
It is safe to pass NULL only if the implementation tolerates it; header does not guarantee this, so pass a valid pointer.

functions.name: XXH32_copyState

requirements: dst_state and src_state must not be NULL.

import os
import random
import struct
from typing import List

# Generator for XXH3 withSecret fuzzers: needs two FUZZ_PARAM_STR buffers
# - data: arbitrary byte string (may be empty). Fuzzer may truncate to 2048.
# - secret: must be >= 136 bytes, preferably high-entropy random-like bytes; fuzzer enforces min 136.
# This generator returns a single bytes buffer containing two length-prefixed blobs:
# [u32 len_data][data][u32 len_secret][secret]
# so that the harness can split into two FUZZ_PARAM_STR calls deterministically.
# If the harness concatenates inputs, it can read the first blob for data and the second for secret.
# The sizes are capped so total <= 4096 bytes.

MAX_TOTAL = 4096
MIN_SECRET = 136
MAX_BLOB = 2048  # fuzzer caps each string at 2048

def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    # Mix printable, zero bytes, and full-range bytes to cover edge cases
    if n <= 0:
        return b""
    chunks: List[bytes] = []
    remaining = n
    while remaining > 0:
        mode = rng.randrange(4)
        take = min(remaining, rng.randint(1, 64))
        if mode == 0:
            # full-range bytes
            chunks.append(bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(take)))
        elif mode == 1:
            # ASCII letters/digits
            alphabet = b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789\n\t \r"
            chunks.append(bytes(alphabet[rng.randrange(len(alphabet))] for _ in range(take)))
        elif mode == 2:
            # repeated single byte (including zeros)
            bval = rng.getrandbits(8)
            chunks.append(bytes([bval]) * take)
        else:
            # patterned increasing bytes
            start = rng.getrandbits(8)
            chunks.append(bytes(((start + i) & 0xFF) for i in range(take)))
        remaining -= take
    return b"".join(chunks)

def _make_data(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Create diverse data lengths: empty, small, block-size boundaries, medium, large
    choices = [0, 1, 3, 15, 16, 31, 32, 63, 64, 127, 128, 255, 256, 1024, 1500, 2048]
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        length = rng.choice(choices)
    else:
        length = rng.randint(0, MAX_BLOB)
    return _rand_bytes(rng, length)

def _make_secret(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Secret must be >= 136, and <= 2048 per fuzzer cap
    # Sometimes use exactly boundary sizes to hit code paths
    boundary_choices = [MIN_SECRET, MIN_SECRET + 1, 192, 256, 512, 1024, 136*2, 2048]
    if rng.random() < 0.6:
        length = rng.choice(boundary_choices)
    else:
        length = rng.randint(MIN_SECRET, MAX_BLOB)
    # High-entropy preferred: mix random and some structured segments
    base = _rand_bytes(rng, length)
    # Occasionally embed known strings or zero runs to explore special cases
    if length >= 32 and rng.random() < 0.3:
        inserts = [b"xxhash", b"SECRET", b"\x00" * 8, struct.pack("<Q", rng.getrandbits(64))]
        pos = rng.randint(0, length - 1)
        ins = rng.choice(inserts)
        cut = min(len(ins), length - pos)
        base = base[:pos] + ins[:cut] + base[pos+cut:]
    return base

def _pack_len_prefixed(blobs: List[bytes]) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    for b in blobs:
        out += struct.pack("<I", len(b))
        out += b
    return bytes(out)

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    data = _make_data(rng)
    secret = _make_secret(rng)

    # Ensure total size <= 4096; if not, trim data preferentially
    header_overhead = 8  # two u32 lengths
    budget = MAX_TOTAL - header_overhead
    if len(data) + len(secret) > budget:
        # Keep secret as-is (important >=136), trim data
        max_data = max(0, budget - len(secret))
        if max_data < 0:
            # In extreme case, trim secret down to fit but keep >= MIN_SECRET
            # Prioritize keeping secret valid; set data empty.
            data = b""
            max_secret = min(len(secret), budget)
            if max_secret < MIN_SECRET:
                # regenerate a minimal valid secret to fit
                secret = _rand_bytes(rng, MIN_SECRET)
            else:
                secret = secret[:max_secret]
        else:
            data = data[:max_data]

    return _pack_len_prefixed([data, secret])
